characters.name: Rocky
characters.breed_foundation: Athletic retriever; cooperative working history, trainability, sustained activity.
characters.ai_behavior: Disciplined, protective, cooperative; searches for high-quality passes before forcing a shot.
characters.strengths: Faceoffs, passing, puck shielding, leadership, two-way reliability.
characters.weaknesses: Cannot match elite sprinters in open ice; moderate change-of-direction speed.
characters.signature_move: Golden Barrage: five-touch deke into a controlled power shot.
characters.arcade_power: Radiant Captain: short team coordination and passing-read boost.
characters.equipment_helmet_brief: Radiant-gold Captain shell; solar-core crest; protective cage; cream/gold away version.

characters.name: Atlas
characters.breed_foundation: Extremely large, powerful mountain-working breed; strength and broad coverage, not sprint specialization.
characters.ai_behavior: Calm and positionally conservative; protects the crease rather than chasing plays.
characters.strengths: Goal coverage, stability, puck stops, controlled rebounds.
characters.weaknesses: Slow lateral recovery and transitions after committing to a save.
characters.signature_move: Fortress Counter: absorb shot, direct rebound to support player.
characters.arcade_power: Avalanche Shield: momentary extended defensive coverage.
characters.equipment_helmet_brief: Oversized blue/white/gold glacier goalie mask; broad jaw/cage, Alpine fortress motif.

characters.name: Billy
characters.breed_foundation: Compact, muscular, low center of gravity; better fictional short-burst power than sustained output.
characters.ai_behavior: Fearless, vocal, contact-seeking; susceptible to overcommitting to a hit.
characters.strengths: Board battles, legal checks, short-range shot power, net-front screening.
characters.weaknesses: High fatigue cost, slow turns, lost position after missed checks.
characters.signature_move: Thunder Jaw Check: decisive legal puck-separating body check.
characters.arcade_power: Bulldog Blitz: temporary checking burst with recovery cost.
characters.equipment_helmet_brief: Broad compact shell with thunder-gold jawline and reinforced cheek plates; blue/gold.

characters.name: Crash
characters.breed_foundation: Highly active herding breed associated with agility, trainability and rapid responsiveness.
characters.ai_behavior: Anticipatory, analytical and precise; rarely chases without cover.
characters.strengths: Play selection, pass timing, anticipatory interceptions, turning, puck control.
characters.weaknesses: Physical matchups against heavyweight defenders; middling shot force.
characters.signature_move: Lightning Read: timed passing-lane interception into breakout.
characters.arcade_power: Tempest Vision: temporary passing-lane visualization and teammate awareness.
characters.equipment_helmet_brief: Navy/silver shell, electric storm-blue channels, tactical clear visor, streamlined air vents.

characters.name: Kefla
characters.breed_foundation: Athletic carriage-associated breed with strong activity capacity and sustained movement.
characters.ai_behavior: Competitive, emotionally intense, aggressively pursues open lanes.
characters.strengths: Breakaways, controlled speed, shooting on motion, fast transition.
characters.weaknesses: Can overextend offensively; lower force in board battles.
characters.signature_move: Emerald Rush: rapid entry and precision release.
characters.arcade_power: Emerald Storm: temporary acceleration and edge-control boost.
characters.equipment_helmet_brief: Lean streamlined shell, fitted Dalmatian ear geometry, emerald micro-accent within team trim.

characters.name: Koda
characters.breed_foundation: Sled-dog lineage prioritizing distance, sustained exertion and pack cooperation.
characters.ai_behavior: Loyal, tenacious and occasionally volatile; pursuit-oriented.
characters.strengths: Extended shifts, forechecking recovery, defensive skating, repeat transitions.
characters.weaknesses: Can overpursue and expose weak-side defense.
characters.signature_move: Blizzard Rush: sustained high-speed recovery chase.
characters.arcade_power: Absolute Zero Drive: temporary lower fatigue accumulation.
characters.equipment_helmet_brief: Frost-blue/black/white shell, ice-crystal geometry, snowflake rear signature.

characters.name: Crimson Emperor
characters.breed_foundation: Sturdy and powerful compact frame; independent, reserved disposition.
characters.ai_behavior: Arrogant, theatrical, shot-focused; seeks individual dominance.
characters.strengths: Slapshot force, net-front shielding, strength, scoring confidence.
characters.weaknesses: Less agile, lower pass preference under pressure.
characters.signature_move: Emperor’s Wrath Slapshot: heavy windup strike.
characters.arcade_power: Crimson Inferno Shot: balanced charged shot with effect trail.
characters.equipment_helmet_brief: Black/deep crimson shell, mane-inspired crown contour, ember micro-details.

characters.name: Razor
characters.breed_foundation: Athletic muscular working breed with notable responsiveness and speed.
characters.ai_behavior: Cool-headed, calculating, opportunistic and highly selective.
characters.strengths: Interceptions, high-speed finishing, breakaways, puck pressure.
characters.weaknesses: May neglect low-glory teamwork; narrow timing windows on risky steals.
characters.signature_move: Phantom Fang Breakaway: precision deke and fast release.
characters.arcade_power: Void Shift: short legal evade animation without puck teleportation.
characters.equipment_helmet_brief: Matte black/crimson shell, void-purple accents, sharply faceted narrow visor.

characters.name: Shockwave
characters.breed_foundation: Compact alert and agile breed often associated with independence.
characters.ai_behavior: Joyful, loud, fearless, impulsive, frequently takes high-risk shots.
characters.strengths: First-step separation, deceptive dekes, dramatic rushes.
characters.weaknesses: Overcommits, susceptible to heavy clean contact, pass discipline.
characters.signature_move: Blaze Fang Rush: rapid three-direction stickhandle.
characters.arcade_power: Solar Sprint: short-burst acceleration and release boost.
characters.equipment_helmet_brief: Orange-gold shell, small-profile ears and flame-edge motif; shared team graphic architecture.

characters.name: Slash
characters.breed_foundation: Provisional Standard Schnauzer comparator: alert, athletic, adaptable working background.
characters.ai_behavior: Quiet, patient, exacting; tracks opportunities and attacks passing lanes.
characters.strengths: Passing-lane denial, stick checking, positional feints, controlled breakouts.
characters.weaknesses: Not a heavy shooter or heavyweight checker.
characters.signature_move: Ghost Fang Steal: timed stick lift/interception.
characters.arcade_power: Phantom Trail: short visual afterimage during a legal dodge.
characters.equipment_helmet_brief: Salt-pepper silver/charcoal, pale spectral-blue trim, ghost-whisker line motif.

characters.name: Sparkplug
characters.breed_foundation: Compact sturdy companion breed; short-muzzled anatomy cautions against depicting long sustained exertion as a real-world trait.
characters.ai_behavior: Combative and exuberant; chaos-oriented, expends energy in bursts.
characters.strengths: Close-range snap shots, quick disruptions and bench-driven impact.
characters.weaknesses: Stamina, reach, repeated acceleration and transition coverage.
characters.signature_move: Sparkplug Special: flash deke + short-range snap shot.
characters.arcade_power: Gigavolt Overcharge: burst attack followed by fatigue increase.
characters.equipment_helmet_brief: Compact gold/black lightning shell, bright yellow electric detailing.

characters.name: Master Sniff
characters.breed_foundation: Large scent-tracking hound renowned for persistence and concentration, not skating speed.
characters.ai_behavior: Playful and patient; studies shooters, redirects rather than overreacting.
characters.strengths: Technical net positioning, puck tracking, rebound direction, shot anticipation.
characters.weaknesses: Lateral recovery and sprint-based puck chase.
characters.signature_move: Harmony Redirect: intentional safe rebound into support lane.
characters.arcade_power: Ancestral Vision: briefly highlights likely shooting options.
characters.equipment_helmet_brief: Amber-halo goalie mask, soft bronze/mahogany trim; extended-ear accommodation.

characters.name: Nova
characters.breed_foundation: Tall fast sighthound, historically developed for visual pursuit and athletic movement.
characters.ai_behavior: Quiet, observant, deliberate; commits when a clean chance emerges.
characters.strengths: Highest top speed, smooth open-ice carry, placement shooting.
characters.weaknesses: Longer start-up compared with tiny acceleration specialists; low physical strength.
characters.signature_move: Starlight Precision: long approach + targeted finish.
characters.equipment_helmet_brief: Elegant purple/black/gold celestial shell, elongated hair-and-ear channel.

characters.name: Penny
characters.breed_foundation: Very small active companion breed; inspired nimble movement but not large-body strength.
characters.ai_behavior: Mischievous, energetic, improvisational; attacks tight openings.
characters.strengths: Peak initial acceleration, tight cuts, collision avoidance, close-control dekes.
characters.weaknesses: Reach, body contact, puck protection in scrums, straight-line top speed.
characters.signature_move: Starburst Blitz: successive micro-turns and evasions.
characters.arcade_power: Supernova Burst: short explosive escape move.
characters.equipment_helmet_brief: Amber-orange/cream/blue lightweight shell, starburst motif, compact fit.

characters.name: Pixy
characters.breed_foundation: Provisional Standard Poodle comparator: athletic, trainable former water retriever.
characters.ai_behavior: Refined, theatrical, calculating; executes precision patterns over brute force.
characters.strengths: Best stickhandling, passing finesse, creative movement and awareness.
characters.weaknesses: Physical contests, heavy contact, low checking force.
characters.signature_move: Prism Cascade: angled dekes into passing/shooting lane.
characters.arcade_power: Prismatic Focus: short puck-control and pass precision boost.
characters.equipment_helmet_brief: Magenta/crimson/white/gold refined shell with pom hairstyle clearance; breed lock pending.
